Arming the self-landing route for PR #12828 (Tier-1, docs only).

Added AFTER the PR was opened, per R6. The declaration at
.github/pr-landing/e41-e42-observed.json says `landing: "self"`, and
pr-landing-guard correctly refused the branch while that claim was unarmed --
"a readiness declaration lands nothing on its own", which is how 7 green PRs
sat unmerged on 2026-09-03.

Why arming is the honest fix rather than flipping to `hold`: none of the five
HOLD_REASONS truthfully describes this PR. It is Tier-1, docs-only
(docs/claude/work/MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json + PIPELINE.jsonl, both inside
TIER1_SURFACE), it edits no landing machinery, depends on no unmerged PR, waits
on no evidence, and the operator asked for no hold. Picking one anyway would be
the false declaration the guard's own MI-226 note exists to prevent.

Contents are not read -- the PATH is the signal.
